reports.title: Steals and busts · distance from expected
reports.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report. Engine points unavailable until the engine first runs.
reports.how: Picks are ordered by round, then pick number. Each pick shows the franchise MFL records, including traded picks. Times use this computer's local time zone. Skipped picks count as made. Refresh to check for changes; if it fails, the app keeps the last good copy. Engine points per game are discounted expected league points per game across the engine’s configured dynasty horizon. Expected is the median current value of drafted players in the same round, not an ADP or draft-day valuation. A bar is the point distance from that baseline (no uncertainty estimate and no letter grade); missing values are not zero. This retrospective comparison is not proof a draft pick was good or bad.

reports.note: Report data unavailable; refresh from MFL to fill this report.
reports.how: Picks are ordered by round, then pick number. Each pick shows the franchise MFL records, including traded picks. Times use this computer's local time zone. Skipped picks count as made. Refresh to check for changes; if it fails, the app keeps the last good copy. Average and median time since the preceding pick, including overnight pauses. The first pick, missing times and times earlier than the preceding pick do not count. A median under one minute is labelled mostly pre-queued; it can also reflect fast selections. MFL does not report pauses.
